 41class OAuth21AuthorizationServer:
 42    def __init__(
 43        self,
 44        signing_key: str,
 45        issuer: str,
 46        *,
 47        token_ttl: int = _DEFAULT_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL,
 48        refresh_token_ttl: int = _DEFAULT_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL,
 49        nonce_ttl: int = _NONCE_TTL_SECONDS,
 50        dpop_replay_ttl: int = _PROOF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS,
 51        store: Optional[OAuthStore] = None,
 52        key_ring: Optional[OAuthKeyRing] = None,
 53    ) -> None:
 54        if not signing_key or len(signing_key) < 16:
 55            raise ValueError('signing_key must be at least 16 characters')
 56        self._key = signing_key.encode('utf-8')
 57        self._key_ring = key_ring or OAuthKeyRing.single(self._key)
 58        self._issuer = issuer
 59        self._token_ttl = token_ttl
 60        self._refresh_token_ttl = refresh_token_ttl
 61        self._nonce_ttl = nonce_ttl
 62        self._dpop_replay_ttl = dpop_replay_ttl
 63        self._store = store or InMemoryOAuthStore()
 64        self._dpop_replay_cache = DPoPReplayCache()
 65
 66    def register_client(
 67        self,
 68        client_id: str,
 69        client_secret: str,
 70        redirect_uris: list[str],
 71        *,
 72        scope: str = 'mcp',
 73    ) -> OAuth21Client:
 74        if self._store.get_client(client_id) is not None:
 75            raise InvalidClientError(f"Client '{client_id}' already registered")
 76        client = OAuth21Client(
 77            client_id=client_id,
 78            client_secret=client_secret,
 79            redirect_uris=frozenset(redirect_uris),
 80            scope=scope,
 81        )
 82        self._store.register_client(client)
 83        return client
 84
 85    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> OAuth21Client:
 86        try:
 87            client = self._store.get_client(client_id)
 88            if client is not None:
 89                return client
 90        except Exception as exc:
 91            raise InvalidClientError(f"Unknown client '{client_id}'") from exc
 92        raise InvalidClientError(f"Unknown client '{client_id}'")
 93
 94    @property
 95    def issuer(self) -> str:
 96        return self._issuer
 97
 98    @property
 99    def key_ring(self) -> OAuthKeyRing:
100        return self._key_ring

102    def create_authorization_code(
103        self,
104        client_id: str,
105        redirect_uri: str,
106        code_challenge: str,
107        *,
108        code_challenge_method: str = 'S256',
109        scope: str = 'mcp',
110        state: Optional[str] = None,
111    ) -> tuple[str, Optional[str]]:
112        client = self.get_client(client_id)
113        if not client.validate_redirect_uri(redirect_uri):
114            raise InvalidClientError(
115                f"Redirect URI '{redirect_uri}' not registered for client '{client_id}'"
116            )
117        if code_challenge_method != 'S256':
118            raise OAuth21Error(
119                f"Unsupported code_challenge_method: '{code_challenge_method}'. "
120                'Only S256 is supported.'
121            )
122
123        code = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
124        self._store.save_code(
125            _AuthorizationCode(
126                code=code,
127                client_id=client_id,
128                redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
129                code_challenge=code_challenge,
130                code_challenge_method=code_challenge_method,
131                expires_at=time.time() + _CODE_TTL_SECONDS,
132                scope=scope,
133            )
134        )
135        self._prune_expired_codes()
136
137        redirect_url = redirect_uri
138        separator = '&' if '?' in redirect_uri else '?'
139        redirect_url += f'{separator}code={code}'
140        if state:
141            redirect_url += f'&state={state}'
142        return redirect_url, state
143
144    def exchange_code(
145        self,
146        code: str,
147        code_verifier: str,
148        *,
149        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
150        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
151        dpop_proof_jwt: Optional[str] = None,
152    ) -> OAuth21TokenResponse:
153        auth_code = self._consume_code(code)
154        self._validate_pkce(auth_code, code_verifier)
155        if client_id:
156            self._validate_client(client_id, client_secret)
157
158        cnf_jkt: Optional[str] = None
159        if dpop_proof_jwt is not None:
160            if not HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY:
161                raise InvalidDPoPError(
162                    'DPoP requires the cryptography library. '
163                    'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth]'
164                )
165            cnf_jkt = self._validate_dpop_and_extract_jkt(dpop_proof_jwt)
166
167        return self._issue_token_pair(
168            client_id=auth_code.client_id,
169            scope=auth_code.scope,
170            cnf_jkt=cnf_jkt,
171        )
172
173    def exchange_refresh_token(
174        self,
175        refresh_token: str,
176        *,
177        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
178        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
179        dpop_proof_jwt: Optional[str] = None,
180    ) -> OAuth21TokenResponse:
181        if not refresh_token:
182            raise InvalidGrantError('refresh_token is required')
183        if client_id:
184            self._validate_client(client_id, client_secret)
185
186        record = self._consume_refresh_token(refresh_token)
187        if record is None:
188            raise InvalidGrantError('Unknown or invalid refresh token')
189        if client_id and record.client_id != client_id:
190            raise InvalidClientError('refresh_token was not issued to this client')
191
192        cnf_jkt: Optional[str] = None
193        if record.cnf_jkt is not None:
194            if dpop_proof_jwt is None:
195                raise InvalidDPoPError(
196                    'DPoP proof required for DPoP-bound refresh token'
197                )
198            if not HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY:
199                raise InvalidDPoPError(
200                    'DPoP requires the cryptography library. '
201                    'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth]'
202                )
203            cnf_jkt = self._validate_dpop_and_extract_jkt(dpop_proof_jwt)
204            if not hmac.compare_digest(cnf_jkt, record.cnf_jkt):
205                raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP key does not match refresh token binding')
206
207        response = self._issue_token_pair(
208            client_id=record.client_id,
209            scope=record.scope,
210            cnf_jkt=cnf_jkt or record.cnf_jkt,
211            family_id=record.family_id,
212        )
213        self._store.record_refresh_reuse(
214            refresh_token,
215            record.family_id,
216            expires_at=record.expires_at,
217        )
218        return response
219
220    def introspect_token(self, token: str) -> OAuth21TokenClaims:
221        header, _ = decode_jwt_unsafe(token)
222        kid = header.get('kid')
223        key = self._key_ring.key_for_validation(
224            kid if isinstance(kid, str) else None, now=time.time()
225        )
226        payload = verify_jwt(token, key, iss=self._issuer)
227        return OAuth21TokenClaims(
228            iss=payload['iss'],
229            sub=payload['sub'],
230            aud=payload['aud'],
231            iat=payload['iat'],
232            exp=payload['exp'],
233            jti=payload['jti'],
234            scope=payload.get('scope', ''),
235            cnf_jkt=(payload.get('cnf') or {}).get('jkt'),
236            raw=payload,
237        )
238
239    def generate_dpop_nonce(self) -> str:
240        nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
241        self._store.save_nonce(nonce, time.time())
242        self._prune_nonces()
243        return nonce
244
245    def validate_dpop_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> bool:
246        created = self._store.consume_nonce(nonce)
247        if created is None:
248            return False
249        return time.time() - created <= self._nonce_ttl
250
251    def metadata(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
252        return {
253            'issuer': self._issuer,
254            'authorization_endpoint': f'{self._issuer}/authorize',
255            'token_endpoint': f'{self._issuer}/token',
256            'token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported': [
257                'client_secret_basic',
258                'none',
259            ],
260            'code_challenge_methods_supported': ['S256'],
261            'dpop_signing_alg_values_supported': (
262                ['ES256', 'ES384', 'ES512', 'RS256'] if HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY else []
263            ),
264            'grant_types_supported': ['authorization_code', 'refresh_token'],
265            'response_types_supported': ['code'],
266        }
267
268    def _issue_token_pair(
269        self,
270        *,
271        client_id: str,
272        scope: str,
273        cnf_jkt: Optional[str] = None,
274        family_id: Optional[str] = None,
275    ) -> OAuth21TokenResponse:
276        now = int(time.time())
277        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
278            'iss': self._issuer,
279            'sub': client_id,
280            'aud': self._issuer,
281            'iat': now,
282            'exp': now + self._token_ttl,
283            'jti': secrets.token_hex(16),
284            'scope': scope,
285        }
286        if cnf_jkt:
287            payload['cnf'] = {'jkt': cnf_jkt}
288
289        token_type = _TOKEN_TYPE_DPOP if cnf_jkt else _TOKEN_TYPE_BEARER
290        access_token = create_jwt(
291            payload,
292            self._key_ring.active_key,
293            header_extra={'kid': self._key_ring.active_kid},
294        )
295
296        refresh_token_value: Optional[str] = None
297        if self._refresh_token_ttl > 0:
298            token_family = family_id or secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
299            refresh_record = _RefreshToken(
300                token=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
301                client_id=client_id,
302                scope=scope,
303                expires_at=time.time() + self._refresh_token_ttl,
304                family_id=token_family,
305                cnf_jkt=cnf_jkt,
306            )
307            self._store.save_refresh_token(refresh_record)
308            refresh_token_value = refresh_record.token
309            self._prune_refresh_tokens()
310
311        return OAuth21TokenResponse(
312            access_token=access_token,
313            token_type=token_type,
314            expires_in=self._token_ttl,
315            scope=scope,
316            refresh_token=refresh_token_value,
317        )
318
319    def _consume_refresh_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[_RefreshToken]:
320        family_id = self._store.get_refresh_reuse_family_id(token)
321        if family_id is not None:
322            self._store.revoke_refresh_family(family_id)
323            raise InvalidGrantError(
324                'Refresh token reuse detected; token family revoked'
325            )
326
327        record = self._store.consume_refresh_token(token)
328        if record is None:
329            return None
330        if record.expires_at < time.time():
331            raise InvalidGrantError('Refresh token expired')
332        return record
333
334    def _prune_refresh_tokens(self) -> None:
335        now = time.time()
336        self._store.prune(now=now, code_ttl_cutoff=now, nonce_ttl=self._nonce_ttl)
337
338    def _consume_code(self, code: str) -> _AuthorizationCode:
339        auth_code = self._store.consume_code(code)
340        if auth_code is None:
341            raise InvalidGrantError('Unknown or already-used authorization code')
342        if auth_code.expires_at < time.time():
343            raise InvalidGrantError('Authorization code expired')
344        return auth_code
345
346    def _validate_pkce(self, auth_code: _AuthorizationCode, code_verifier: str) -> None:
347        challenge = compute_s256_challenge(code_verifier)
348        if not hmac.compare_digest(
349            challenge.encode(), auth_code.code_challenge.encode()
350        ):
351            raise InvalidGrantError('Invalid code_verifier: PKCE challenge mismatch')
352
353    def _validate_client(self, client_id: str, client_secret: Optional[str]) -> None:
354        client = self.get_client(client_id)
355        if client_secret is None:
356            return
357        validator = getattr(self._store, 'validate_client_secret', None)
358        if callable(validator):
359            if not validator(client_id, client_secret):
360                raise InvalidClientError('Invalid client_secret')
361            return
362        if not hmac.compare_digest(
363            client_secret.encode('utf-8'), client.client_secret.encode('utf-8')
364        ):
365            raise InvalidClientError('Invalid client_secret')
366
367    def _validate_dpop_and_extract_jkt(self, proof_jwt: str) -> str:
368        header, payload = decode_jwt_unsafe(proof_jwt)
369        if header.get('typ') != _DPOP_PROOF_TYP:
370            raise InvalidDPoPError(f"DPoP proof typ must be '{_DPOP_PROOF_TYP}'")
371        jwk = header.get('jwk')
372        if not isinstance(jwk, dict):
373            raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP proof header must include a jwk')
374        _verify_dpop_signature(proof_jwt, jwk)
375        iat = payload.get('iat', 0)
376        now = time.time()
377        if abs(now - iat) > self._dpop_replay_ttl:
378            raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP proof is too old')
379        self._dpop_replay_cache.remember_once(
380            payload.get('jti'), iat=float(iat), now=now, ttl=self._dpop_replay_ttl
381        )
382        return compute_jwk_thumbprint(jwk)
383
384    def _prune_expired_codes(self) -> None:
385        now = time.time()
386        self._store.prune(now=now, code_ttl_cutoff=now, nonce_ttl=self._nonce_ttl)
387
388    def _prune_nonces(self) -> None:
389        now = time.time()
390        self._store.prune(now=now, code_ttl_cutoff=now, nonce_ttl=self._nonce_ttl)

113        if not client.validate_redirect_uri(redirect_uri):
114            raise InvalidClientError(
115                f"Redirect URI '{redirect_uri}' not registered for client '{client_id}'"
116            )
117        if code_challenge_method != 'S256':
118            raise OAuth21Error(
119                f"Unsupported code_challenge_method: '{code_challenge_method}'. "
120                'Only S256 is supported.'
121            )
122
123        code = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
124        self._store.save_code(
125            _AuthorizationCode(
126                code=code,
127                client_id=client_id,
128                redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
129                code_challenge=code_challenge,
130                code_challenge_method=code_challenge_method,
131                expires_at=time.time() + _CODE_TTL_SECONDS,
132                scope=scope,
133            )
134        )
135        self._prune_expired_codes()
136
137        redirect_url = redirect_uri
138        separator = '&' if '?' in redirect_uri else '?'
139        redirect_url += f'{separator}code={code}'
140        if state:
141            redirect_url += f'&state={state}'
142        return redirect_url, state
def exchange_code( self, code: str, code_verifier: str, *, client_id: str | None = None, client_secret: str | None = None, dpop_proof_jwt: str | None = None) -> OAuth21TokenResponse: 
144    def exchange_code(
145        self,
146        code: str,
147        code_verifier: str,
148        *,
149        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
150        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
151        dpop_proof_jwt: Optional[str] = None,
152    ) -> OAuth21TokenResponse:
153        auth_code = self._consume_code(code)
154        self._validate_pkce(auth_code, code_verifier)
155        if client_id:
156            self._validate_client(client_id, client_secret)
157
158        cnf_jkt: Optional[str] = None
159        if dpop_proof_jwt is not None:
160            if not HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY:
161                raise InvalidDPoPError(
162                    'DPoP requires the cryptography library. '
163                    'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth]'
164                )
165            cnf_jkt = self._validate_dpop_and_extract_jkt(dpop_proof_jwt)
166
167        return self._issue_token_pair(
168            client_id=auth_code.client_id,
169            scope=auth_code.scope,
170            cnf_jkt=cnf_jkt,
171        )
def exchange_refresh_token( self, refresh_token: str, *, client_id: str | None = None, client_secret: str | None = None, dpop_proof_jwt: str | None = None) -> OAuth21TokenResponse: 
173    def exchange_refresh_token(
174        self,
175        refresh_token: str,
176        *,
177        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
178        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
179        dpop_proof_jwt: Optional[str] = None,
180    ) -> OAuth21TokenResponse:
181        if not refresh_token:
182            raise InvalidGrantError('refresh_token is required')
183        if client_id:
184            self._validate_client(client_id, client_secret)
185
186        record = self._consume_refresh_token(refresh_token)
187        if record is None:
188            raise InvalidGrantError('Unknown or invalid refresh token')
189        if client_id and record.client_id != client_id:
190            raise InvalidClientError('refresh_token was not issued to this client')
191
192        cnf_jkt: Optional[str] = None
193        if record.cnf_jkt is not None:
194            if dpop_proof_jwt is None:
195                raise InvalidDPoPError(
196                    'DPoP proof required for DPoP-bound refresh token'
197                )
198            if not HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY:
199                raise InvalidDPoPError(
200                    'DPoP requires the cryptography library. '
201                    'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth]'
202                )
203            cnf_jkt = self._validate_dpop_and_extract_jkt(dpop_proof_jwt)
204            if not hmac.compare_digest(cnf_jkt, record.cnf_jkt):
205                raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP key does not match refresh token binding')
206
207        response = self._issue_token_pair(
208            client_id=record.client_id,
209            scope=record.scope,
210            cnf_jkt=cnf_jkt or record.cnf_jkt,
211            family_id=record.family_id,
212        )
213        self._store.record_refresh_reuse(
214            refresh_token,
215            record.family_id,
216            expires_at=record.expires_at,
217        )
218        return response

222        kid = header.get('kid')
223        key = self._key_ring.key_for_validation(

230            aud=payload['aud'],

233            jti=payload['jti'],
234            scope=payload.get('scope', ''),
235            cnf_jkt=(payload.get('cnf') or {}).get('jkt'),
236            raw=payload,
237        )

247        if created is None:

249        return time.time() - created <= self._nonce_ttl

 24class OAuth21ResourceServer:
 25    def __init__(
 26        self,
 27        signing_key: str,
 28        issuer: str,
 29        *,
 30        key_ring: Optional[OAuthKeyRing] = None,
 31    ) -> None:
 32        if not signing_key or len(signing_key) < 16:
 33            raise ValueError('signing_key must be at least 16 characters')
 34        self._key = signing_key.encode('utf-8')
 35        self._key_ring = key_ring or OAuthKeyRing.single(self._key)
 36        self._issuer = issuer
 37        self._dpop_replay_cache = DPoPReplayCache()
 38
 39    def validate_request(
 40        self,
 41        authorization_header: Optional[str],
 42        dpop_header: Optional[str],
 43        method: str,
 44        url: str,
 45    ) -> OAuth21TokenClaims:
 46        if not authorization_header:
 47            raise OAuth21Error('Missing Authorization header')
 48        parts = authorization_header.split(None, 1)
 49        if len(parts) < 2:
 50            raise OAuth21Error('Malformed Authorization header')
 51        scheme, token = parts[0], parts[1]
 52        if scheme not in (_TOKEN_TYPE_DPOP, _TOKEN_TYPE_BEARER):
 53            raise OAuth21Error(f"Unsupported auth scheme: '{scheme}'")
 54        header, _ = decode_jwt_unsafe(token)
 55        kid = header.get('kid')
 56        key = self._key_ring.key_for_validation(
 57            kid if isinstance(kid, str) else None, now=time.time()
 58        )
 59        claims = verify_jwt(token, key, iss=self._issuer)
 60        if scheme == _TOKEN_TYPE_DPOP or claims.get('cnf', {}).get('jkt'):
 61            if not HAS_CRYPTOGRAPHY:
 62                raise InvalidDPoPError(
 63                    'DPoP token validation requires the cryptography library. '
 64                    'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth]'
 65                )
 66            self._validate_dpop_binding(claims, dpop_header, method, url, token)
 67        return OAuth21TokenClaims(
 68            iss=claims['iss'],
 69            sub=claims['sub'],
 70            aud=claims['aud'],
 71            iat=claims['iat'],
 72            exp=claims['exp'],
 73            jti=claims['jti'],
 74            scope=claims.get('scope', ''),
 75            cnf_jkt=(claims.get('cnf') or {}).get('jkt'),
 76            raw=claims,
 77        )
 78
 79    def _validate_dpop_binding(
 80        self,
 81        claims: dict[str, Any],
 82        dpop_header: Optional[str],
 83        method: str,
 84        url: str,
 85        _token: str,
 86    ) -> None:
 87        token_jkt = (claims.get('cnf') or {}).get('jkt')
 88        if not token_jkt:
 89            return
 90        if not dpop_header:
 91            raise InvalidDPoPError('Missing DPoP header for DPoP-bound token')
 92        header, payload = decode_jwt_unsafe(dpop_header)
 93        if header.get('typ') != _DPOP_PROOF_TYP:
 94            raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP proof has wrong typ')
 95        if payload.get('htm', '').upper() != method.upper():
 96            raise InvalidDPoPError(
 97                f"DPoP htm mismatch: expected '{method.upper()}', "
 98                f"got '{payload.get('htm', '')}'"
 99            )
100        if payload.get('htu', '') != url:
101            raise InvalidDPoPError(
102                f"DPoP htu mismatch: expected '{url}', got '{payload.get('htu', '')}'"
103            )
104        iat = payload.get('iat', 0)
105        now = time.time()
106        if abs(now - iat) > _PROOF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
107            raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP proof is too old')
108        self._dpop_replay_cache.remember_once(
109            payload.get('jti'), iat=float(iat), now=now, ttl=_PROOF_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
110        )
111        jwk = header.get('jwk')
112        if not isinstance(jwk, dict):
113            raise InvalidDPoPError('DPoP proof header missing jwk')
114        _verify_dpop_signature(dpop_header, jwk)
115        proof_jkt = compute_jwk_thumbprint(jwk)
116        if not hmac.compare_digest(proof_jkt.encode(), token_jkt.encode()):
117            raise InvalidDPoPError(
118                'DPoP proof key does not match token confirmation key'
119            )

Base class for protocol classes.

Protocol classes are defined as::

class Proto(Protocol):
    def meth(self) -> int:
        ...

Such classes are primarily used with static type checkers that recognize structural subtyping (static duck-typing).

For example::

class C:
    def meth(self) -> int:
        return 0

def func(x: Proto) -> int:
    return x.meth()

func(C())  # Passes static type check

See PEP 544 for details. Protocol classes decorated with @typing.runtime_checkable act as simple-minded runtime protocols that check only the presence of given attributes, ignoring their type signatures. Protocol classes can be generic, they are defined as::

class GenProto[T](Protocol):
    def meth(self) -> T:
        ...

1866def _no_init_or_replace_init(self, *args, **kwargs):
1867    cls = type(self)
1868
1869    if cls._is_protocol:
1870        raise TypeError('Protocols cannot be instantiated')
1871
1872    # Already using a custom `__init__`. No need to calculate correct
1873    # `__init__` to call. This can lead to RecursionError. See bpo-45121.
1874    if cls.__init__ is not _no_init_or_replace_init:
1875        return
1876
1877    # Initially, `__init__` of a protocol subclass is set to `_no_init_or_replace_init`.
1878    # The first instantiation of the subclass will call `_no_init_or_replace_init` which
1879    # searches for a proper new `__init__` in the MRO. The new `__init__`
1880    # replaces the subclass' old `__init__` (ie `_no_init_or_replace_init`). Subsequent
1881    # instantiation of the protocol subclass will thus use the new
1882    # `__init__` and no longer call `_no_init_or_replace_init`.
1883    for base in cls.__mro__:
1884        init = base.__dict__.get('__init__', _no_init_or_replace_init)
1885        if init is not _no_init_or_replace_init:
1886            cls.__init__ = init
1887            break
1888    else:
1889        # should not happen
1890        cls.__init__ = object.__init__
1891
1892    cls.__init__(self, *args, **kwargs)

 60class InMemoryOAuthStore:
 61    def __init__(self) -> None:
 62        self.clients: dict[str, OAuth21Client] = {}
 63        self.codes: dict[str, _AuthorizationCode] = {}
 64        self.nonces: dict[str, float] = {}
 65        self.refresh_tokens: dict[str, _RefreshToken] = {}
 66        self.refresh_reuse: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
 67
 68    def register_client(self, client: OAuth21Client) -> None:
 69        self.clients[client.client_id] = client
 70
 71    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[OAuth21Client]:
 72        return self.clients.get(client_id)
 73
 74    def save_code(self, code: _AuthorizationCode) -> None:
 75        self.codes[code.code] = code
 76
 77    def consume_code(self, code: str) -> Optional[_AuthorizationCode]:
 78        return self.codes.pop(code, None)
 79
 80    def save_nonce(self, nonce: str, created_at: float) -> None:
 81        self.nonces[nonce] = created_at
 82
 83    def get_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
 84        return self.nonces.get(nonce)
 85
 86    def consume_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
 87        return self.nonces.pop(nonce, None)
 88
 89    def delete_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> None:
 90        self.nonces.pop(nonce, None)
 91
 92    def prune(self, *, now: float, code_ttl_cutoff: float, nonce_ttl: float) -> None:
 93        expired_codes = [c for c, ac in self.codes.items() if ac.expires_at < now]
 94        for code in expired_codes:
 95            del self.codes[code]
 96        expired_nonces = [
 97            nonce for nonce, created in self.nonces.items() if now - created > nonce_ttl
 98        ]
 99        for nonce in expired_nonces:
100            del self.nonces[nonce]
101        expired_refresh = [
102            t for t, rec in self.refresh_tokens.items() if rec.expires_at < now
103        ]
104        for token in expired_refresh:
105            del self.refresh_tokens[token]
106        expired_reuse = [t for t, (_, exp) in self.refresh_reuse.items() if exp < now]
107        for token in expired_reuse:
108            del self.refresh_reuse[token]
109
110    def save_refresh_token(self, record: _RefreshToken) -> None:
111        self.refresh_tokens[record.token] = record
112
113    def consume_refresh_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[_RefreshToken]:
114        return self.refresh_tokens.pop(token, None)
115
116    def record_refresh_reuse(
117        self, token: str, family_id: str, *, expires_at: float
118    ) -> None:
119        self.refresh_reuse[token] = (family_id, expires_at)
120
121    def is_refresh_reused(self, token: str) -> bool:
122        return self.get_refresh_reuse_family_id(token) is not None
123
124    def get_refresh_reuse_family_id(self, token: str) -> Optional[str]:
125        entry = self.refresh_reuse.get(token)
126        if entry is None:
127            return None
128        family_id, expires_at = entry
129        if expires_at < time.time():
130            del self.refresh_reuse[token]
131            return None
132        return family_id

 92    def prune(self, *, now: float, code_ttl_cutoff: float, nonce_ttl: float) -> None:
 93        expired_codes = [c for c, ac in self.codes.items() if ac.expires_at < now]
 94        for code in expired_codes:
 95            del self.codes[code]
 96        expired_nonces = [
 97            nonce for nonce, created in self.nonces.items() if now - created > nonce_ttl
 98        ]
 99        for nonce in expired_nonces:
100            del self.nonces[nonce]
101        expired_refresh = [
102            t for t, rec in self.refresh_tokens.items() if rec.expires_at < now
103        ]
104        for token in expired_refresh:
105            del self.refresh_tokens[token]
106        expired_reuse = [t for t, (_, exp) in self.refresh_reuse.items() if exp < now]
107        for token in expired_reuse:
108            del self.refresh_reuse[token]

144    def __init__(self, path: Path | str) -> None:
145        self.path = Path(path)
146        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
147        self._lock = threading.RLock()
148        self._initialize()

150    def register_client(self, client: OAuth21Client) -> None:
151        secret_hash, salt = _hash_client_secret(client.client_secret)
152        with self._connect() as conn:
153            conn.execute(
154                """
155                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO oauth_clients
156                    (client_id, client_secret, client_secret_hash,
157                     client_secret_salt, client_secret_kdf,
158                     redirect_uris_json, scope)
159                VALUES (?, '', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
160                """,
161                (
162                    client.client_id,
163                    secret_hash,
164                    salt,
165                    _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF,
166                    json.dumps(sorted(client.redirect_uris), separators=(',', ':')),
167                    client.scope,
168                ),
169            )

171    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[OAuth21Client]:
172        with self._connect() as conn:
173            row = conn.execute(
174                """
175                SELECT client_id, redirect_uris_json, scope
176                FROM oauth_clients
177                WHERE client_id = ?
178                """,
179                (client_id,),
180            ).fetchone()
181        if row is None:
182            return None
183        redirect_uris = frozenset(str(uri) for uri in json.loads(row[1]))
184        return OAuth21Client(
185            client_id=str(row[0]),
186            client_secret='',
187            redirect_uris=redirect_uris,
188            scope=str(row[2]),
189        )
190
191    def validate_client_secret(self, client_id: str, client_secret: str) -> bool:
192        with self._connect() as conn:
193            row = conn.execute(
194                """
195                SELECT client_secret_hash, client_secret_salt, client_secret_kdf
196                FROM oauth_clients
197                WHERE client_id = ?
198                """,
199                (client_id,),
200            ).fetchone()
201        if row is None or row[2] != _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF:
202            return False
203        expected = bytes(row[0])
204        salt = bytes(row[1])
205        actual = _hash_client_secret_with_salt(client_secret, salt)
206        return hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected)

396    def _initialize(self) -> None:
397        with self._connect() as conn:
398            conn.executescript(
399                """
400                PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
401                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_metadata (
402                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
403                    value TEXT NOT NULL
404                );
405                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_clients (
406                    client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
407                    client_secret TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
408                    client_secret_hash BLOB,
409                    client_secret_salt BLOB,
410                    client_secret_kdf TEXT,
411                    redirect_uris_json TEXT NOT NULL,
412                    scope TEXT NOT NULL
413                );
414                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_codes (
415                    code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
416                    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
417                    redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
418                    code_challenge TEXT NOT NULL,
419                    code_challenge_method TEXT NOT NULL,
420                    expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
421                    scope TEXT NOT NULL
422                );
423                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_codes_expires_at
424                    ON oauth_codes(expires_at);
425                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_nonces (
426                    nonce TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
427                    created_at REAL NOT NULL
428                );
429                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_nonces_created_at
430                    ON oauth_nonces(created_at);
431                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_refresh_tokens (
432                    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
433                    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
434                    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
435                    expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
436                    family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
437                    cnf_jkt TEXT
438                );
439                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_expires_at
440                    ON oauth_refresh_tokens(expires_at);
441                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_refresh_tokens_family_id
442                    ON oauth_refresh_tokens(family_id);
443                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oauth_refresh_reuse (
444                    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
445                    family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
446                    expires_at REAL NOT NULL
447                );
448                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oauth_refresh_reuse_expires_at
449                    ON oauth_refresh_reuse(expires_at);
450                """
451            )
452            self._migrate_clients(conn)
453            conn.execute(
454                """
455                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO oauth_metadata (key, value)
456                VALUES ('schema_version', ?)
457                """,
458                (str(_SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION),),
459            )
460
461    def _connect(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
462        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=30, isolation_level=None)
463        conn.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')
464        conn.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000')
465        return conn
466
467    def _migrate_clients(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
468        columns = {
469            str(row[1])
470            for row in conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(oauth_clients)').fetchall()
471        }
472        if 'client_secret_hash' not in columns:
473            conn.execute('ALTER TABLE oauth_clients ADD COLUMN client_secret_hash BLOB')
474        if 'client_secret_salt' not in columns:
475            conn.execute('ALTER TABLE oauth_clients ADD COLUMN client_secret_salt BLOB')
476        if 'client_secret_kdf' not in columns:
477            conn.execute('ALTER TABLE oauth_clients ADD COLUMN client_secret_kdf TEXT')
478        for row in conn.execute(
479            """
480            SELECT client_id, client_secret
481            FROM oauth_clients
482            WHERE client_secret_hash IS NULL AND client_secret != ''
483            """
484        ).fetchall():
485            secret_hash, salt = _hash_client_secret(str(row[1]))
486            conn.execute(
487                """
488                UPDATE oauth_clients
489                SET client_secret = '',
490                    client_secret_hash = ?,
491                    client_secret_salt = ?,
492                    client_secret_kdf = ?
493                WHERE client_id = ?
494                """,
495                (secret_hash, salt, _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF, str(row[0])),
496            )

 76class PostgreSQLOAuthStore:
 77    """Cross-host OAuthStore backed by PostgreSQL.
 78
 79    Uses DELETE ... RETURNING for atomic one-time consume of auth codes and
 80    nonces, preserving one-time-use semantics across multiple processes and
 81    hosts sharing the same database.
 82
 83    Args:
 84        dsn: libpq connection string or URL (e.g. 'postgresql://user:pw@host/db').
 85        _conn_factory: Optional callable returning a DB-API 2.0 connection.
 86            Intended for testing; omit in production.
 87    """
 88
 89    def __init__(
 90        self,
 91        dsn: str,
 92        *,
 93        _conn_factory: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None,
 94    ) -> None:
 95        if _conn_factory is None and not HAS_PSYCOPG2:
 96            raise ImportError(
 97                'PostgreSQL OAuthStore requires psycopg2. '
 98                'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth-pg]'
 99            )
100        self._dsn = dsn
101        self._conn_factory: Callable[[], Any] = _conn_factory or (
102            lambda: psycopg2.connect(dsn)
103        )
104        self._initialize()
105
106    @contextmanager
107    def _conn(self) -> Iterator[Any]:
108        conn = self._conn_factory()
109        try:
110            yield conn
111            conn.commit()
112        except Exception:
113            conn.rollback()
114            raise
115        finally:
116            conn.close()
117
118    def _initialize(self) -> None:
119        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
120            cur.execute(_PG_SCHEMA)
121
122    def register_client(self, client: OAuth21Client) -> None:
123        secret_hash, salt = _hash_client_secret(client.client_secret)
124        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
125            cur.execute(
126                """
127                    INSERT INTO oauth_clients
128                        (client_id, client_secret_hash, client_secret_salt,
129                         client_secret_kdf, redirect_uris_json, scope)
130                    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
131                    ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE
132                        SET client_secret_hash = EXCLUDED.client_secret_hash,
133                            client_secret_salt = EXCLUDED.client_secret_salt,
134                            redirect_uris_json = EXCLUDED.redirect_uris_json,
135                            scope = EXCLUDED.scope
136                    """,
137                (
138                    client.client_id,
139                    secret_hash,
140                    salt,
141                    _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF,
142                    json.dumps(sorted(client.redirect_uris)),
143                    client.scope,
144                ),
145            )
146
147    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[OAuth21Client]:
148        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
149            cur.execute(
150                'SELECT client_id, redirect_uris_json, scope '
151                'FROM oauth_clients WHERE client_id = %s',
152                (client_id,),
153            )
154            row = cur.fetchone()
155        if row is None:
156            return None
157        redirect_uris = frozenset(str(u) for u in json.loads(row[1]))
158        return OAuth21Client(
159            client_id=str(row[0]),
160            client_secret='',
161            redirect_uris=redirect_uris,
162            scope=str(row[2]),
163        )
164
165    def validate_client_secret(self, client_id: str, client_secret: str) -> bool:
166        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
167            cur.execute(
168                'SELECT client_secret_hash, client_secret_salt, client_secret_kdf '
169                'FROM oauth_clients WHERE client_id = %s',
170                (client_id,),
171            )
172            row = cur.fetchone()
173        if row is None or row[2] != _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF:
174            return False
175        expected = bytes(row[0])
176        salt = bytes(row[1])
177        actual = _hash_client_secret_with_salt(client_secret, salt)
178        return hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected)
179
180    def save_code(self, code: _AuthorizationCode) -> None:
181        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
182            cur.execute(
183                """
184                    INSERT INTO oauth_codes
185                        (code, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge,
186                         code_challenge_method, expires_at, scope)
187                    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
188                    ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
189                    """,
190                (
191                    code.code,
192                    code.client_id,
193                    code.redirect_uri,
194                    code.code_challenge,
195                    code.code_challenge_method,
196                    code.expires_at,
197                    code.scope,
198                ),
199            )
200
201    def consume_code(self, code: str) -> Optional[_AuthorizationCode]:
202        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
203            cur.execute(
204                """
205                    DELETE FROM oauth_codes WHERE code = %s
206                    RETURNING code, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge,
207                              code_challenge_method, expires_at, scope
208                    """,
209                (code,),
210            )
211            row = cur.fetchone()
212        if row is None:
213            return None
214        return _AuthorizationCode(
215            code=str(row[0]),
216            client_id=str(row[1]),
217            redirect_uri=str(row[2]),
218            code_challenge=str(row[3]),
219            code_challenge_method=str(row[4]),
220            expires_at=float(row[5]),
221            scope=str(row[6]),
222        )
223
224    def save_nonce(self, nonce: str, created_at: float) -> None:
225        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
226            cur.execute(
227                'INSERT INTO oauth_nonces (nonce, created_at) VALUES (%s, %s) '
228                'ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING',
229                (nonce, created_at),
230            )
231
232    def get_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
233        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
234            cur.execute(
235                'SELECT created_at FROM oauth_nonces WHERE nonce = %s', (nonce,)
236            )
237            row = cur.fetchone()
238        return float(row[0]) if row is not None else None
239
240    def consume_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
241        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
242            cur.execute(
243                'DELETE FROM oauth_nonces WHERE nonce = %s RETURNING created_at',
244                (nonce,),
245            )
246            row = cur.fetchone()
247        return float(row[0]) if row is not None else None
248
249    def delete_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> None:
250        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
251            cur.execute('DELETE FROM oauth_nonces WHERE nonce = %s', (nonce,))
252
253    def prune(self, *, now: float, code_ttl_cutoff: float, nonce_ttl: float) -> None:
254        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
255            cur.execute(
256                'DELETE FROM oauth_codes WHERE expires_at < %s', (code_ttl_cutoff,)
257            )
258            cur.execute(
259                'DELETE FROM oauth_nonces WHERE %s - created_at > %s',
260                (now, nonce_ttl),
261            )
262            cur.execute(
263                'DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_tokens WHERE expires_at < %s', (now,)
264            )
265            cur.execute('DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_reuse WHERE expires_at < %s', (now,))
266
267    def save_refresh_token(self, record: _RefreshToken) -> None:
268        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
269            cur.execute(
270                """
271                    INSERT INTO oauth_refresh_tokens
272                        (token, client_id, scope, expires_at, family_id, cnf_jkt)
273                    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
274                    ON CONFLICT (token) DO UPDATE
275                        SET expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
276                    """,
277                (
278                    record.token,
279                    record.client_id,
280                    record.scope,
281                    record.expires_at,
282                    record.family_id,
283                    record.cnf_jkt,
284                ),
285            )
286
287    def consume_refresh_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[_RefreshToken]:
288        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
289            cur.execute(
290                """
291                    DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_tokens WHERE token = %s
292                    RETURNING token, client_id, scope, expires_at, family_id, cnf_jkt
293                    """,
294                (token,),
295            )
296            row = cur.fetchone()
297        if row is None:
298            return None
299        return _RefreshToken(
300            token=str(row[0]),
301            client_id=str(row[1]),
302            scope=str(row[2]),
303            expires_at=float(row[3]),
304            family_id=str(row[4]),
305            cnf_jkt=str(row[5]) if row[5] is not None else None,
306        )
307
308    def record_refresh_reuse(
309        self, token: str, family_id: str, *, expires_at: float
310    ) -> None:
311        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
312            cur.execute(
313                """
314                    INSERT INTO oauth_refresh_reuse (token, family_id, expires_at)
315                    VALUES (%s, %s, %s)
316                    ON CONFLICT (token) DO UPDATE
317                        SET family_id = EXCLUDED.family_id,
318                            expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
319                    """,
320                (token, family_id, expires_at),
321            )
322
323    def is_refresh_reused(self, token: str) -> bool:
324        return self.get_refresh_reuse_family_id(token) is not None
325
326    def get_refresh_reuse_family_id(self, token: str) -> Optional[str]:
327        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
328            cur.execute(
329                'SELECT family_id, expires_at FROM oauth_refresh_reuse WHERE token = %s',
330                (token,),
331            )
332            row = cur.fetchone()
333        if row is None:
334            return None
335        if float(row[1]) < time.time():
336            with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
337                cur.execute(
338                    'DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_reuse WHERE token = %s', (token,)
339                )
340            return None
341        return str(row[0])
342
343    def revoke_refresh_family(self, family_id: str) -> None:
344        with self._conn() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
345            cur.execute(
346                'DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_tokens WHERE family_id = %s',
347                (family_id,),
348            )
349            cur.execute(
350                'DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_reuse WHERE family_id = %s',
351                (family_id,),
352            )

 37    carry a TTL matching their expiry. Nonces carry a fixed TTL supplied at
 38    construction time. Atomic consume uses a Lua script (GET + DEL in one
 39    round-trip) so one-time semantics hold across multiple hosts.
 40
 41    Args:
 42        url: Redis connection URL (default 'redis://localhost:6379').
 43        nonce_ttl: Seconds before a nonce expires (default 300).
 44        key_prefix: Namespace prefix for all Redis keys (default 'oauth:').
 45        _client: Pre-built Redis client for testing; omit in production.
 46    """
 47
 48    def __init__(
 49        self,
 50        url: str = 'redis://localhost:6379',
 51        *,
 52        nonce_ttl: int = 300,
 53        key_prefix: str = 'oauth:',
 54        _client: Any | None = None,
 55    ) -> None:
 56        if _client is None and not HAS_REDIS:
 57            raise ImportError(
 58                'Redis OAuthStore requires redis-py. '
 59                'Install with: pip install teaagent[oauth-redis]'
 60            )
 61        self._nonce_ttl = nonce_ttl
 62        self._key_prefix = key_prefix
 63        if _client is not None:
 64            self._redis = _client
 65        else:
 66            self._redis = _redis_mod.Redis.from_url(url, decode_responses=True)
 67        self._consume_script = self._redis.register_script(_LUA_CONSUME)
 68
 69    def _k(self, kind: str, ident: str) -> str:
 70        return f'{self._key_prefix}{kind}:{ident}'
 71
 72    def register_client(self, client: OAuth21Client) -> None:
 73        secret_hash, salt = _hash_client_secret(client.client_secret)
 74        data = json.dumps(
 75            {
 76                'client_id': client.client_id,
 77                'client_secret_hash': secret_hash.hex(),
 78                'client_secret_salt': salt.hex(),
 79                'client_secret_kdf': _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF,
 80                'redirect_uris': sorted(client.redirect_uris),
 81                'scope': client.scope,
 82            }
 83        )
 84        self._redis.set(self._k('client', client.client_id), data)
 85
 86    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[OAuth21Client]:
 87        raw = self._redis.get(self._k('client', client_id))
 88        if raw is None:
 89            return None
 90        data = json.loads(raw)
 91        return OAuth21Client(
 92            client_id=data['client_id'],
 93            client_secret='',
 94            redirect_uris=frozenset(data['redirect_uris']),
 95            scope=data['scope'],
 96        )
 97
 98    def validate_client_secret(self, client_id: str, client_secret: str) -> bool:
 99        raw = self._redis.get(self._k('client', client_id))
100        if raw is None:
101            return False
102        data = json.loads(raw)
103        if data.get('client_secret_kdf') != _CLIENT_SECRET_KDF:
104            return False
105        expected = bytes.fromhex(data['client_secret_hash'])
106        salt = bytes.fromhex(data['client_secret_salt'])
107        actual = _hash_client_secret_with_salt(client_secret, salt)
108        return hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected)
109
110    def save_code(self, code: _AuthorizationCode) -> None:
111        data = json.dumps(
112            {
113                'code': code.code,
114                'client_id': code.client_id,
115                'redirect_uri': code.redirect_uri,
116                'code_challenge': code.code_challenge,
117                'code_challenge_method': code.code_challenge_method,
118                'expires_at': code.expires_at,
119                'scope': code.scope,
120            }
121        )
122        ttl = max(1, int(code.expires_at - time.time()))
123        # NX: do not overwrite an already-saved code (idempotent save).
124        self._redis.set(self._k('code', code.code), data, ex=ttl, nx=True)
125
126    def consume_code(self, code: str) -> Optional[_AuthorizationCode]:
127        raw = self._consume_script(keys=[self._k('code', code)])
128        if raw is None:
129            return None
130        data = json.loads(raw)
131        return _AuthorizationCode(
132            code=data['code'],
133            client_id=data['client_id'],
134            redirect_uri=data['redirect_uri'],
135            code_challenge=data['code_challenge'],
136            code_challenge_method=data['code_challenge_method'],
137            expires_at=float(data['expires_at']),
138            scope=data['scope'],
139        )
140
141    def save_nonce(self, nonce: str, created_at: float) -> None:
142        self._redis.set(
143            self._k('nonce', nonce),
144            str(created_at),
145            ex=self._nonce_ttl,
146            nx=True,
147        )
148
149    def get_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
150        raw = self._redis.get(self._k('nonce', nonce))
151        return float(raw) if raw is not None else None
152
153    def consume_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> Optional[float]:
154        raw = self._consume_script(keys=[self._k('nonce', nonce)])
155        return float(raw) if raw is not None else None
156
157    def delete_nonce(self, nonce: str) -> None:
158        self._redis.delete(self._k('nonce', nonce))
159
160    def prune(self, *, now: float, code_ttl_cutoff: float, nonce_ttl: float) -> None:
161        # Redis TTL handles expiration automatically; explicit prune is a no-op.
162        pass
163
164    def save_refresh_token(self, record: _RefreshToken) -> None:
165        data = json.dumps(
166            {
167                'token': record.token,
168                'client_id': record.client_id,
169                'scope': record.scope,
170                'expires_at': record.expires_at,
171                'family_id': record.family_id,
172                'cnf_jkt': record.cnf_jkt,
173            }
174        )
175        ttl = max(1, int(record.expires_at - time.time()))
176        self._redis.set(self._k('refresh', record.token), data, ex=ttl)
177        self._redis.sadd(self._k('refresh_family', record.family_id), record.token)
178
179    def consume_refresh_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[_RefreshToken]:
180        raw = self._consume_script(keys=[self._k('refresh', token)])
181        if raw is None:
182            return None
183        data = json.loads(raw)
184        self._redis.srem(self._k('refresh_family', data['family_id']), token)
185        return _RefreshToken(
186            token=data['token'],
187            client_id=data['client_id'],
188            scope=data['scope'],
189            expires_at=float(data['expires_at']),
190            family_id=data['family_id'],
191            cnf_jkt=data.get('cnf_jkt'),
192        )
193
194    def record_refresh_reuse(
195        self, token: str, family_id: str, *, expires_at: float
196    ) -> None:
197        ttl = max(1, int(expires_at - time.time()))
198        self._redis.set(
199            self._k('refresh_reuse', token),
200            json.dumps({'family_id': family_id}),
201            ex=ttl,
202        )
203
204    def is_refresh_reused(self, token: str) -> bool:
205        return self.get_refresh_reuse_family_id(token) is not None
206
207    def get_refresh_reuse_family_id(self, token: str) -> Optional[str]:
208        raw = self._redis.get(self._k('refresh_reuse', token))
209        if raw is None:
210            return None
211        return json.loads(raw)['family_id']
212
213    def revoke_refresh_family(self, family_id: str) -> None:
214        family_key = self._k('refresh_family', family_id)
215        tokens = self._redis.smembers(family_key)
216        if tokens:
217            self._redis.delete(
218                *[self._k('refresh', token) for token in tokens],
219                family_key,
220            )
221        reuse_pattern = self._k('refresh_reuse', '*')
222        for key in self._redis.scan_iter(match=reuse_pattern):
223            raw = self._redis.get(key)
224            if raw is None:
225                continue
226            if json.loads(raw).get('family_id') == family_id:
227                self._redis.delete(key)

513@dataclass(frozen=True)
514class OAuthKeyRing:
515    active_kid: str
516    keys: Mapping[str, bytes]
517    rotation_window_seconds: int = 0
518    deprecated_at: Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
519
520    @classmethod
521    def single(cls, key: bytes, *, kid: str = 'default') -> 'OAuthKeyRing':
522        return cls(active_kid=kid, keys={kid: key})
523
524    @property
525    def active_key(self) -> bytes:
526        return self.keys[self.active_kid]
527
528    def rotate(self, new_kid: str, *, now: Optional[float] = None) -> 'OAuthKeyRing':
529        if new_kid not in self.keys:
530            raise ValueError(
531                f'Cannot rotate to unknown kid {new_kid!r}; available: {list(self.keys)}'
532            )
533        ts = now if now is not None else time.time()
534        updated: dict[str, float] = dict(self.deprecated_at)
535        updated[self.active_kid] = ts
536        return OAuthKeyRing(
537            active_kid=new_kid,
538            keys=self.keys,
539            rotation_window_seconds=self.rotation_window_seconds,
540            deprecated_at=updated,
541        )
542
543    def key_for(self, kid: Optional[str]) -> bytes:
544        if kid and kid in self.keys:
545            return self.keys[kid]
546        return self.active_key
547
548    def key_for_validation(
549        self, kid: Optional[str], *, now: Optional[float] = None
550    ) -> bytes:
551        resolved = kid if (kid and kid in self.keys) else self.active_kid
552        key = self.keys[resolved]
553        if resolved != self.active_kid and self.rotation_window_seconds > 0:
554            deprecated_ts = self.deprecated_at.get(resolved)
555            if deprecated_ts is not None:
556                elapsed = (now if now is not None else time.time()) - deprecated_ts
557                if elapsed > self.rotation_window_seconds:
558                    from teaagent.oauth21._types import JWTError
559
560                    raise JWTError(
561                        f'Signing key {resolved!r} is outside rotation window '
562                        f'({elapsed:.0f}s > {self.rotation_window_seconds}s)'
563                    )
564        return key

def create_jwt( payload: dict[str, typing.Any], key: bytes, *, header_extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str: 
36def create_jwt(
37    payload: dict[str, Any],
38    key: bytes,
39    *,
40    header_extra: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
41) -> str:
42    header: dict[str, Any] = {'alg': 'HS256', 'typ': 'JWT'}
43    if header_extra:
44        header.update(header_extra)
45    header_b64 = _b64url_encode(json.dumps(header, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
46    payload_b64 = _b64url_encode(json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
47    signing_input = f'{header_b64}.{payload_b64}'.encode('ascii')
48    sig = hmac.new(key, signing_input, hashlib.sha256).digest()
49    return f'{header_b64}.{payload_b64}.{_b64url_encode(sig)}'
def verify_jwt( token: str, key: bytes, *, aud: str | None = None, iss: str | None = None, allow_expired: bool = False) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
52def verify_jwt(
53    token: str,
54    key: bytes,
55    *,
56    aud: Optional[str] = None,
57    iss: Optional[str] = None,
58    allow_expired: bool = False,
59) -> dict[str, Any]:
60    parts = token.split('.')
61    if len(parts) != 3:
62        raise JWTError('Invalid JWT format')
63    header_b64, payload_b64, sig_b64 = parts
64    signing_input = f'{header_b64}.{payload_b64}'.encode('ascii')
65    expected_sig = hmac.new(key, signing_input, hashlib.sha256).digest()
66    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_sig, _b64url_decode(sig_b64)):
67        raise JWTError('Invalid JWT signature')
68    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(_b64url_decode(payload_b64))
69    if not allow_expired and 'exp' in payload:
70        exp = payload['exp']
71        if isinstance(exp, (int, float)) and exp < time.time():
72            raise JWTError('Token expired')
73    if aud is not None and payload.get('aud') != aud:
74        raise JWTError(f"Invalid audience: expected '{aud}'")
75    if iss is not None and payload.get('iss') != iss:
76        raise JWTError(f"Invalid issuer: expected '{iss}'")
77    return payload
def decode_jwt_unsafe(token: str) -> tuple[dict[str, typing.Any], dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
80def decode_jwt_unsafe(token: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
81    parts = token.split('.')
82    if len(parts) < 2:
83        raise JWTError('Invalid JWT format')
84    try:
85        header: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(_b64url_decode(parts[0]))
86        payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(_b64url_decode(parts[1]))

 92def compute_jwk_thumbprint(jwk: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
